description: Provides evaluation context for a formula including the source sheet, owning workbook, and sheet index for named range resolution.

members.name: ResolveCellRef
members.description: Resolves a cell reference to its raw value.

members.name: ResolveNamedRange
members.description: Resolves a named range to its underlying A1 reference or constant value. Sheet-scope names take precedence over workbook-scope names on their sheet.

members.name: ResolveRangeRef
members.description: Resolves a range reference to a list of raw values.

members.name: SheetIndex
members.description: The zero-based index of the sheet being evaluated.

members.name: Workbook
members.description: The workbook that owns the sheet, used for named range lookup.
